title: Empirical restricted Fourier weight
statement: For a natural number $m$ and a finite list of rational observations, the empirical restricted Fourier weight is the sum of the observations divided by $m$.
hypotheses_covered: observations is a finite list of rational numbers
caveat: The definition also permits $m=0$, in which case the quotient uses rational division by zero.
